verdict.rationale: Omnara lets you configure which agent actions require approval and lets agents pause to ask for input, which could be used to gate on a plan before code changes, but there is no documented feature specifically for presenting/reviewing an implementation plan before code is written. Community feedback (omnara-comm-5) explicitly notes that reviewing/QAing agent work remains unsolved with tools like this, casting doubt on how robust the approval gate is for plan review. Missing for 10: dedicated plan-approval workflow/UI, evidence that approvals occur pre-implementation rather than mid-execution, and independent confirmation the feature works as intended.
